newsitem.title: USA: Pan Am to give kids free flights in summer.
newsitem.headline: Pan Am to give kids free flights in summer.

text.p: Children will fly for free when traveling with an adult on Pan Am Corp under a new promotion this summer, the carrier said in a statement Friday.
The offer is available for children between the ages of two and 17 traveling with an adult in the continental U.S.
The airline said that the special offer is being made available for sale until July 4 for travel from now through August 30.
The "Kids Fly Free" promotion requires that the child travels with the adult and has a minimum stay of three days and a 30 day maximum stay.

Each adult paying the full summer promotional fare is entitled to one free accompanying child. Any number of additional children may travel with the adult at a 50 percent discount from the adult's fare.
Tickets must be purchased within 72 hours of the booking and are nonrefundable.
